source: ADR-0006 revision 5.1 (section 17.9; orchestrator ruling I-6, M05 wave 2 U7): CatalogRequest::SetDefaultProfile, transcribed from the ruling's text, never from the code under test. `environment` is omitted when absent (the runtime's own); `profile` is always written and null clears.

view.what: inspect policies carries default_profiles only when one is set; an empty list is omitted

dry_run.source: ADR-0006 revision 5.1 (section 17.9): CatalogRequest::ApplyImport.dry_run, transcribed from the contract owner's delta (item 1). Omitted when false, so every earlier apply_import document is unchanged; required capability trusted-work/1 either way.

requests.what: a real import writes no dry_run key

closed_bundle.source: ADR-0006 revision 5.1 (section 17.9), item 2: the four bundle types are closed (deny_unknown_fields). Each path is a key added at that level of the dry-run bundle above; every one makes the request undecodable.

policy_target_result.source: ADR-0006 revision 5.1 (section 17.9) C2: the result of a targeted policy action, transcribed from U3's published result (crates/app/src/operations/stop_m05.rs targeted_view before the typed form). cutoff_at is always written (null when none); revoked only for stop.

results.what: stop of a policy, nothing to revoke

decision_policies.source: ADR-0006 revision 5.1 (section 17.9) C1: the policies a targeted widening's decision view lists, as {policy_id, revision}.
